description: Flat stamped steel mounting bracket/strap with exactly three in-line holes: two plain holes and one serrated hole.

face.front: outer edge is chamfered/rolled; plain holes are visibly countersunk/dished and not flat through-holes
face.back: outer edge is square/sharp; plain holes are visibly flat through-holes with no countersink/dish
face.unresolved: edge/countersink profile is unreadable or the visible plain-hole geometry cannot distinguish flat through-holes from countersunk/dished holes

va.location: between the middle hole and the plain end-hole, on the side of the middle hole opposite the serrated hole

decision.check: Inspect the largest hole and determine whether the circumference of the bore/opening clearly has the required serrated/toothed pattern.
decision.defect_when: The required serrated/toothed pattern is not visibly present on the circumference of the largest hole.
decision.clear_when: One or more clearly visible sections of the circumference of the largest hole show the required serrated/toothed pattern. The full circumference does not need to be visible if the visible teeth clearly establish that the serration is present.
decision.review_when: Never use NEEDS_REVIEW for serration presence. If the required teeth cannot be clearly confirmed, treat serration as missing.
ignore: Damage or appearance inside the bore.
decision.boundary: Count only clearly visible teeth forming the serrated circumference of the largest hole. Teeth may be visible on only part of the circumference; a clear toothed pattern on a visible section is sufficient to establish that serration is present.
decision.localization: Tight box around the largest hole including the visible serrated circumference and bore.

decision.check: After the front face is established, inspect the complete VA marking at its designated location.
decision.defect_when: VA is present, but one or more required characters is visibly incomplete, partially formed, or clearly shallower/fainter than the other VA characters.
decision.clear_when: VA is clearly present and all required characters are fully formed with consistent visible depth and definition.
decision.review_when: The VA characters cannot be reliably judged because glare, shadow, dirt, blur, or insufficient resolution prevents comparison of their formation or depth.
ignore: A blank VA zone on the back face; this is normal.
Normal lighting variation that does not change the apparent character formation.
Minor visual variation that does not clearly indicate incomplete or shallow embossing.
decision.boundary: Incomplete/shallow embossing requires a visible defect in the embossed character itself; a merely faint image caused by lighting or image quality is not enough.
decision.localization: Tight box around the affected VA character or characters.

decision.check: First establish front versus back using the outer edge and the two plain holes. Treat a square/sharp edge together with flat, non-countersunk plain holes as the back face; treat a chamfered/rolled edge together with countersunk/dished plain holes as the front face. Only after this orientation decision inspect the VA zone.
decision.defect_when: Front face is confirmed by a chamfered/rolled edge and countersunk/dished plain holes, and the designated VA zone is blank.
decision.clear_when: Back face is confirmed by a square/sharp edge and flat through-holes, and the VA zone is blank; or front face is confirmed and VA is present.
decision.review_when: The edge and plain-hole geometry cannot reliably establish front versus back.
ignore: A blank VA zone on a confirmed back face; this is normal and must not be reported as embossing_missing.
Using the blank VA zone itself to decide front versus back.
Glare, shadow or dirt mistaken for a missing mark.
decision.localization: Tight box around the designated VA zone only when front face is confirmed and VA is actually missing.
decision.boundary: Embossing_missing is possible only after the front face has been positively established. Never infer a missing embossing defect from a blank VA zone when the back face is confirmed.
